Key Account Manager – SITS I SecureDevice, Denmark

Location: Copenhagen (Hybrid)

Reports to: Sales Manager, SITS I SecureDevice Denmark

Company: SecureDevice – Part of the SITS Group

Scope: Denmark & Nordic Growth

About SITS I SecureDevice

SITS I SecureDevice is part of the SITS Group, headquartered in Switzerland and active across Northern Europe. We are one of Denmark’s leading cybersecurity solution providers, trusted by over 100 Danish customers across private and public sectors.

We operate across seven specialized practices, providing end-to-end services from advisory and architecture to managed security, detection & response, and compliance.

What truly sets us apart is our culture — a people-first mindset where trust, collaboration, and professional curiosity define how we work. At SITS I SecureDevice, we believe that great people create great business.

The Role

As Key Account Manager, you will play a central role in strengthening and expanding relationships with SITS I SecureDevice’s key customers. You’ll act as a trusted advisor who understands the customer’s business, identifies opportunities, and connects them with the right SITS expertise.

You will collaborate closely with our consultants, technical specialists, and leadership team to ensure customer satisfaction, long-term engagement, and mutual growth.

You will report directly to the Sales Manager, SITS SecureDevice Denmark, and work as part of a high-performing, people-focused commercial team driving growth in Denmark and across the Nordics.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and grow relationships with key customers across private and public sectors.

• Engage deeply with clients to understand their business and security needs, translating them into tailored SecureDevice solutions.

• Drive consultative sales across our seven cybersecurity practice areas in close collaboration with technical specialists and consultants.

• Identify and develop new opportunities within existing accounts.

• Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention through proactive engagement and consistent follow-up.

• Contribute to sales reporting, forecasting, and pipeline management, ensuring transparency and structure.

• Represent and strengthen SITS I SecureDevice’s people-first and trust-based culture in all customer interactions.

Your Profile

You are a relationship-driven professional with a passion for cybersecurity and a strong commercial mindset. You understand how to build trust, create value, and translate complex technical topics into clear business outcomes.

You likely bring:

• Experience in B2B account management or solution sales, preferably within cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, or managed services.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders.

• A solid understanding of cybersecurity principles such as threat management, compliance, or cloud security.

• A structured, proactive, and collaborative approach to your work.

• Fluency in Danish and English (spoken and written).

Why SecureDevice

• Be part of a people-first culture built on trust, collaboration, and professional growth.

• Work alongside some of Denmark’s most skilled cybersecurity experts.

• Manage relationships with over 100 active customers and contribute to our Nordic growth journey.

• Competitive compensation and career development opportunities within the SITS Group.

Ready to build trusted partnerships that make a difference in cybersecurity?

We’d love to hear from you.

Description

As a Public Relations Intern at Pangaea Youth Network, you will play a vital role in shaping the organisation’s public image and strengthening our outreach efforts in Horsens and nearby cities. You will work closely with our team to promote our initiatives, support community engagement, and help build stronger relationships with local and regional stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include creating clear and engaging communication materials (press releases, posts, short articles, and updates), supporting our social media presence, and helping coordinate public-facing events and activities. A key part of this internship is also stakeholder communication and partnership building: you will actively contact relevant stakeholders and help us strengthen connections with local kommuner, youth NGOs, educational institutions (including højskoler and universities), and other organisations that can support youth participation and community initiatives.

You will support outreach through emails and follow-ups, keep track of stakeholder communication, and assist in arranging meetings and collaborations between relevant stakeholders and PYN’s general manager. This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys communication, networking, and building meaningful connections with people and institutions.

Benefits

• 
Flexible internship length tailored to your availability

• 
Exciting and supportive community atmosphere

• 
Cozy office space in Horsens, Denmark

• 
Exclusive access to Erasmus+ projects (youth exchanges and training courses) where you can learn new skills and meet international participants. For Erasmus+ training courses and youth exchanges abroad (5–10 days), travel, food, and accommodation costs are covered by EU funds

• 
Opportunities for skill development through workshops and events

Join us in making a positive impact in the lives of young people and gain practical experience in public relations, stakeholder communication, and community outreach.

Note: While we are unable to provide monetary support, we offer a strong learning environment and non-monetary benefits that can significantly develop your skills and experience in youth engagement and international cooperation.

Turn your scientific expertise into commercial impact

Are you a scientist with a couple of years of experience in the lab, and a growing pull toward the commercial side of science? Do you want to use your analytical background as a springboard - building relationships, driving customer outcomes, and eventually growing into a broader commercial career - rather than staying in the lab? If you're energized by science but you can already picture yourself on the customer-facing side of it, this role is built for that transition.

What we do

Evosep aims to improve quality of life and patient care by radically innovating protein based clinical diagnostics. Making sample preparation and separation before MS analysis 10 times faster and 100 times more robust will enable truly large cohort studies for biomarker validation and provide the foundation for precision medicine.

Why this role is a great place to start your commercial career

Most people don't start their career knowing they want to end up in commercial roles - they discover it. If you've enjoyed the moments in your scientific work where you got to explain your results, train a colleague, or convince a skeptical reviewer, there's a good chance you'd enjoy this even more.

As a Customer Success Manager, your science degree isn't something you leave behind - it's your credibility with every customer you work with. You'll use it every day to understand their workflows, speak their language, and be trusted as someone who genuinely gets the science. On top of that, you'll build a second skillset most scientists never get the chance to develop: reading account health, spotting growth opportunities, structuring commercial conversations, and working hand-in-hand with Sales, Marketing, and Application Specialists.

It's a role at the intersection of two worlds - and a natural stepping stone if you're aiming toward Account Management, Sales, Marketing, or broader commercial leadership down the line. You won't be doing this alone: you'll be mentored by experienced colleagues in Sales and Applications, and supported by a team that wants to see you grow into the commercial side of the business.

Key tasks and responsibilities

Build and grow customer relationships

• Own the day-to-day relationship with a portfolio of accounts across Academia, Pharma, Biotech, and Clinical

• Learn to run structured account check-ins - understanding how customers are using their instruments, what's going well, and where they need more support

• Start spotting expansion opportunities (new applications, additional capacity) and hand them off to Sales - with mentoring, you'll grow into owning more of that commercial read yourself

• Track adoption and usage trends, and translate what you see into a clear read on account health

Keep customers running smoothly

• Be the customer's go-to contact for contract renewals, service timing, and logistics questions

• Coordinate with our Service and Application teams to keep installs, maintenance, and calibrations on track

• Help new customers get set up for success from day one

Represent Evosep and capture customer feedback

• Attend conferences, user meetings, and customer workshops - representing Evosep and building your own network in the field

• Capture customer feedback and feed it back to Product and Marketing - your scientific background will help you translate what customers really mean

• Help build a pipeline of reference customers and advocates within your accounts

Qualifications

• A degree in Analytical Science, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field

• Around 2–3 years of experience, e.g. from a lab, research, or an early technical/commercial role - hands-on proteomics and LC-MS experience is a big plus, but not a hard requirement

• A genuine curiosity about the commercial side of science, and the drive to build a career there - not just to support it

• Strong communication skills - comfortable explaining technical topics clearly to different audiences

• A proactive, relationship-driven mindset; you follow through and you don't wait to be asked twice

• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

• Based in Denmark, with willingness to travel across Europe and occasionally further; happy working from home and from our HQ in Odense

• Valid Class B driver's license

What We Offer

• A genuine path from scientific expertise into a commercial career, with mentoring from experienced Sales and Applications colleagues

• A competitive compensation and benefits package — details shared during the application process

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supportive colleagues who are genuinely driven by purpose

• A dynamic, open culture where challenging the status quo is a team sport

• The opportunity to grow with a fast-expanding company at the center of proteomics innovation

• A healthy work-life balance — we know you have a life outside the office, and we want you to enjoy it

• Modern office facilities in Odense, including a cozy atrium courtyard — perfect for sunny lunch breaks and Friday bars

• And that’s just the beginning! Curious? Read more at www.evosep.com/careers

Does This Position Sound Like A Match?

Hit the apply button below! We can’t wait to hear from you and learn more about why you’d be a great fit for the Evosep team.

What Happens After I Send My Application?

We’re eager to welcome our new Customer Success Manager as soon as possible, so we’ll be reviewing applications and conducting interviews on an ongoing basis. That means if you’re interested, don’t wait too long! And don’t worry: If you take the time to apply, we’ll make sure to respond. At the very least, you’ll hear from us once the hiring process is complete - we know applying takes effort.

Living in Odense

Join a thriving life science ecosystem with strong university-industry collaboration and exciting career opportunities. Discover why professionals from around the world choose to live and work in Odense - a city that combines innovation, work-life balance, and exceptional quality of life. Learn more here Career in Odense - Invest in Odense.

We are looking for Network Advisory consultants to join our network advisory team in Ballerup.

Do you have passion for delivering network solutions to your clients? Would you like to influence the short- and long-term design of a business-critical client network infrastructure solution?

Your responsibilities as a Network Advisor

You will play the key, strategic role, acting as a link between our network Advisory team, our customer, our delivery organization, and external business partners.

As a Network Advisory Consultant, you will be attending client meetings, and it will be your responsibility to recognize and understand customers’ commercial needs, and in cooperation with the Aeven Advisory specialists, offering stable network solutions meeting the expected quality.

You will:

• Act as trusted advisor and Network Advisor for customers’ projects.

• Have responsibility for parts of the network architecture provided to customers.

• Participate in network projects and other activities as an engineer, network architect and/or implementor.

• Have a presales role in new projects

• Design, configure and advise the customer on the installed technologies.

• Transform our customers’ needs into well-documented solutions

Your qualifications

You have a couple of years of technical background in network infrastructure, and you can cover some of the technical domain within security, core or enterprise network.

You have:

• Relevant and adequate work experience and education (at least 1 year).

• Fluent in spoken Danish or Scandinavian language, and Danish in written and spoken.

• A strong commercial mindset

• Professional approach

• Some knowledge of several of the network technologies below:

• Cisco Firewalls (ASA, Firepower)

• Cisco Enterprise

• Cisco Core

• Palo Alto suite

• Fortinet

• Nokia

It will be a plus if you also have experience with:

• Citrix

• DelEMC

• VMware

• VXRail

• Microsoft

• Oracle

• DWDM

It will work to your advantage if you have experience with Advisory, from a customer or supplier perspective, as well as acting as a consultant.

Regardless of your background, the right drive and passion for creating strong relationships with our stakeholders is what we are looking for.

You will be supported by a broad range of Aeven specialists, so you will gain knowledge of technologies that you are less familiar with. You must be able to adopt new technologies to benefit our customers immediately.

CCNA level certification is a must in the Cisco technologies you advance in. Similar levels of certification on other technologies mentioned above is also a must.

Practical information:

• The position is 37 hours a week

• This position requires partly physical presence in Ballerup, partly physical presence on customer sites all over Denmark, and ability to work from home every now and then.

Contact:

If you want to know more about this position, please contact Bettina Svendsen on besv@aevengroup.com.

We interview candidates continuously. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Please submit your application in English.

At Aeven, we’re on a mission to keep digital infrastructure critical to the lives of millions, safe, secure, and productive. And to do this, we need sharp minds, capable hands, and most importantly, positive personalities that are eager to collaborate, contribute, develop their skills, and make a difference.

When you join Aeven, you join a culture of expertise, inclusion, and growth where people matter. Your professional growth is valuable to us, and we will support you all the way – whether you ‘re interested in developing greater depth within your area of expertise, want to broaden your scope of skills, or wish to pursue new roles in our organization.

Are you driven by network architecture, cloud connectivity, and designing solutions that connect infrastructure and business needs? Do you thrive in a role where architectural responsibility, Azure, and complex stakeholder landscapes go hand in hand? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect – Network to join our Infrastructure & Platform team in Middelfart. The role centers around a growing focus on internal network architecture, where strong competencies are needed to ensure scalable, secure, and cloud‑enabled network solutions across the organization.

As Senior Solution Architect, you work holistically with our IT landscape and take architectural responsibility for network design across both on‑prem and cloud environments, with Azure as a central platform. You act as the link between business needs, project management, vendors, and internal IT functions, ensuring that network and cloud solutions are aligned with architecture principles, roadmap, and governance requirements.

Your responsibilities

You will play a key role in defining and maintaining the architectural direction within the network domain, with a strong focus on how network and cloud interact in a hybrid setup.

Your responsibilities include:

• Designing and owning network architecture across on‑prem and Azure environments, with a clear focus on cloud connectivity, scalability, and security.

• Ensuring tight alignment between network architecture and cloud initiatives, making Azure an integrated and visible part of the overall infrastructure design.

• Addressing a growing complexity and demand within the network area by defining robust, future‑proof solutions that support business growth.

• Working closely with project managers on task definition, prioritization, and architectural guidance to ensure solutions are delivered as intended.

• Collaborating with vendors and partners, ensuring that requirements, architecture, and expectations are clearly defined and adhered to.

• Ensuring that network architectures meet security, compliance, and governance requirements in close collaboration with Cybersecurity.

• Staying up to date on network and cloud technologies and sharing architectural knowledge across the organization.

Your profile

You are an experienced solution architect with deep expertise in networking and a solid understanding of cloud platforms – especially Azure. You understand how architectural decisions within the network domain impact cloud capabilities, operations, and business outcomes.

We expect that you bring:

• Strong experience with network architecture in enterprise environments.

• Hands‑on experience with Azure and solid understanding of cloud networking concepts.

• Experience working in hybrid infrastructures, connecting on‑prem and cloud environments.

• The ability to translate business needs into clear, robust architectural solutions.

• Experience collaborating across stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex architectures to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

• Fluency in Danish and English.

About you

You thrive in an architectural role with responsibility and influence, and you are motivated by creating long‑term, sustainable solutions. You are comfortable challenging existing designs and driving architectural improvements where needed, always with a business perspective in mind.

Ready to apply?

If this sounds like the next step for you, we look forward to receiving your application and CV. We review applications on an ongoing basis and schedule interviews as soon as we identify suitable candidates.

If you have questions about the position, please feel free to contact Tommy Aamand, Director of Technology, at +45 26 86 34 30.

About Bunker Holding

Bunker Holding is the global leader in purchasing, selling, and supplying marine fuel and lube oil as well as providing risk management and other vital services for the shipping industry. The company operates via more than 1,660 ports worldwide and is present in 32 countries with 62 offices and more than 1,100 skilled employees.

The group has a long history but remains forward‑looking and focused on answering the needs and challenges of an ever‑changing industry.

Bunker Holding is the largest company in the USTC Group, a family‑owned company based in Denmark. USTC holds activities in oil & energy, ship owning, shipping & door‑to‑door logistics, risk management, car activities, IT, sustainable energy, and environment & recycling. The USTC Group is currently present with more than 160 offices in 40 countries and employs more than 4,300 people worldwide.

Read more at https://www.bunker-holding.com/

Are you passionate about driving innovation through technical excellence and ensuring that products meet compliance standards? Are you capable of translating grid connection compliance standards into applicable requirements, specification and implementation to shape the future of power management? If so, you could be the perfect fit for this exciting role at DEIF A/S!

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

About the Job

As an Embedded SW Developer, you’ll be an integral part of DEIF’s skilled embedded SW Team focussing on measurement and protection. Your primary focus will be ensuring our products not only meet various grid connection standards but also exceed market requirements. You will play a key role building our new products from collaborating on specifications through implementation to quality assurance though a proper continuous integration enabled pipeline. Additionally, you will help ensure expansions of functionality in existing products and maintaining our solutions towards quality and security needs.

Working tasks & responsibilities

• Develop SW within the embedded SW domain for our diverse products.

• Ensure pipeline integration and continuous integration.

• Documenting functionality and setup methods, while supporting technical documentation.

• Maintenance and quality assurance of the developed SW.

• Improve structure of frameworks and apply/improve platform structure across products.

In addition to an exciting job full of challenging tasks, you will experience a professional work environment where collaboration, interdependence, and co-determination are watchwords. DEIF will provide great opportunities to grow plus different benefits and perks supporting your health and well-being.

What you’ll bring

• An engineering degree involving SW heavy engineering, preferably within electrical engineering or a similar field.

• Adapt SW developer skills in HW near code (C, C++)

• Solid experience in SW engineering principes like SOLID additionally to creational, structural and behavioural design patterns.

• Well versed and varied experience with SW engineering tools.

• Advanced communication skills in English and preferably also in Danish

• Experience within three phase power systems is a highly desired bonus.

You are thorough, detail-oriented, and thrive in managing complex challenges. Your problem-solving abilities and clear communication make you a trusted team player and decision-maker. Above all, you’re courageous in tackling challenges and confident in your ability to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Interviews for this role are expected to take place as suitable applicants are screened, or a suitable candidate is found.

Why join DEIF?

At DEIF A/S, you’ll be part of a family-owned company with strong values and a culture built on trust, openness, and collaboration. You’ll experience a professional and highly engaged working environment, where we’re curious on each other’s perspectives and encourage respectful, honest dialogue that drives growth. Our strength lies in responsibility, teamwork, and the courage to innovate – that’s what drives us forward.

In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, we offer you:

• Flexible work arrangements, including home office days and access to our satellite office in Silkeborg

• The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in state-of-the-art facilities

• On-the-job training and knowledge sharing with skilled employees

• In-house canteen and physiotherapist at our headquarters

• Fitness breaks, social events, and much more supporting your wellbeing.

Want to know more about working at DEIF? Visit our career page today!

Are you passionate about rare endocrine diseases and advancing medical innovation? Do you have experience within Medical Affairs and enjoy translating science into meaningful impact for patients and healthcare professionals?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Global Medical Scientist.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Global Medical Scientist to join our Global Medical Affairs organization. In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert within rare endocrinology and support the development and execution of global medical strategies across Ascendis Pharma’s growing portfolio. You will work closely with colleagues across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Commercial, Market Access, and local affiliate teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of global initiatives.

You will be joining the Global Medical Office and report directly to the Senior Global Director, Global Medical Office. The position is based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support the development and execution of global medical strategies, medical narratives, and strategic imperatives across the Ascendis Pharma portfolio.

• Generate and communicate medical insights related to disease areas, treatment landscapes, competitive developments, and unmet patient needs.

• Support global medical education initiatives, congress activities, advisory boards, and engagement with key external stakeholders, including KOLs, patient advocacy groups, and medical societies.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support evidence generation activities, including real-world evidence, observational studies, and Phase IV programs.

• Partner closely with local medical teams to ensure alignment and execution of global medical strategies and tactics.

Qualifications and Skills

You hold an advanced scientific degree such as MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent, and have at least 5 years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, preferably in Medical Affairs.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong experience interpreting, communicating, and applying clinical data in a scientific and strategic context.

• Experience working within endocrinology, rare diseases, or other specialized therapeutic areas.

• Solid understanding of Medical Affairs, drug development processes, and global pharmaceutical compliance requirements.

• Proven ability to build trusted partnerships and work effectively in a complex global matrix organization.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both internal and external stakeholders.

Key competencies

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be scientifically curious, collaborative, and able to translate complex medical information into actionable insights. You are proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable navigating a dynamic international environment.

Travel: Approximately 20% international travel.

Office: Copenhagen, Denmark or the US, Princeton

Apply now

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform – applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Senior Medical Director Anette Arnberg at aag@ascendispharma.com or Senior Medical Director Annette Hommelgaard at aho@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

As the summer holiday period approaches, you may experience a longer response time than usual. We truly appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding. We look forward to reviewing your application as soon as possible.

Are you a skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer with experience across the full AI solution lifecycle, from model development and training to deployment and operation at scale? Do you enjoy combining deep technical expertise with practical, business-focused solutions that drive innovation and improve processes? If so, you could be our next Senior AI Engineer!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI at JYSK by helping accelerate AI adoption across the organization. As part of a high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll contribute to our strategic ambition of integrating AI into business processes across the company. If you’re passionate about technical innovation and enjoy solving real-world business challenges with AI, we’d love to hear from you!

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A dynamic workplace in an international company focused on growth, innovation, and continuous development.

• A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

• A flexible work-from-home policy that supports a healthy work-life balance.

• Attractive employee benefits, including staff discounts across the Lars Larsen Group and a variety of social events throughout the year.

• Access to internal training, courses, and learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

• A welcoming and supportive culture, complemented by a comprehensive onboarding programme to help you succeed from day one.

• A low-politics, low-ego culture where collaboration, ownership, and high standards are valued.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing AI solutions that drive innovation, enable data-driven decision-making, improve operations, and enhance customer experiences. You will bridge software engineering and machine learning, focusing on model experimentation, deployment, and integration to create scalable, efficient, and reusable solutions.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Develop and scale end-to-end AI applications and MLOps pipelines using your deep software engineering background.

• Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI agent systems, from orchestration and tool integration to production deployment and monitoring.

• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embedding workflows, and semantic search solutions where appropriate.

• Research, experiment with, and develop classical and state-of-the-art AI models across NLP, Computer Vision, Deep Generative Models, Graph Neural Networks, and Reinforcement Learning to improve and optimize JYSK’s business processes.

• Collaborate closely with data, AI, and platform engineers on complex projects to integrate cutting-edge models into impactful AI products.

• Managing AI workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ensure optimal performance and resource efficiency.

• Working with architects to refine AI solution design and contributing to solution planning phases.

• Supporting end-users of AI solutions with a "you build it, you own it" mindset.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Holds a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. A PhD is considered an advantage.

• Has 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, designing and implementing AI solutions at scale using Python.

• Has a strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, with experience spanning both discriminative and generative models applied to structured data, natural language, and vision.

Aarhus/Aalborg/Copenhagen

Internship Duration: 2 February 2027 to 25 June 2027

Do you want to work for an Architecture firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be a Landscape Architect/Urban Planner? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree within Urban/Landscape Architecture field or similar.

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

The Role

Our Purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

You will be leading a group of engineers while directly contributing to the successful outcomes of the team by supporting excellent engineering practices, working on the team’s roadmap and strategy and enabling rapid delivery of high quality software. You will be responsible for supporting your direct reports in becoming awesome Plandayers, empowering them to deliver high-quality software to customers and fostering the growth of a world-class engineering culture.

You’ll maintain a working environment in which your team can do their best work predictably and sustainably. You’ll make sure the team has all the information they need and the right feedback loops in place to discover and deliver valuable, usable, and buildable outcomes. You’ll monitor and look to support the operational health of your team and products, aiming for resilience.

You will support your team to hone their engineering skills and grow as individuals in order to meet the capabilities required for the team. Your focus will be on driving engineering initiatives and ensuring the team makes progress towards their goals.

What you’ll do

Leadership, People & Culture

• 
Lead, develop and grow a high performing team through coaching, mentoring and setting a clear direction by connecting the work they do to the Planday Engineering and Product strategic objectives.

• 
Support each member of your team to identify, grow and develop engineering capabilities and career.

• 
Work closely together with the product manager and product designer in your team, forming the trio that enables a both autonomous and empowered team.

• 
Create a culture of psychological safety and inclusion. Ensure the health of your team is monitored, that all members of your team are empowered to raise ideas and concerns, and that everyone contributes to improvements in how the team works together.

• 
Driving continuous improvement through reviewing, developing and implementing best practice ways of working.

• 
Help to cultivate a fun, appreciative, rewarding, innovative and results-driven culture that lives and breathes our Planday values.

• 
Attract, recruit and retain capable individuals, building on and complementing the diversity of teams.

Engineering & Delivery

• 
Ensure your team's delivery pipeline is flowing at a predictable and sustainable pace, raising and addressing blockers as appropriate.

• 
Take part in our continuous exploration and implementation of AI tooling in our development practices.

• 
You come with a strong technical background and are able to be hands-on in the team and take part in the engineering work.

• 
Ensure accurate, fit for purpose and sustainable delivery systems exist in your team. You'll be responsible for your team providing informed estimates, delivery forecasting, capacity planning, and associated reporting.

• 
Understand and advocate Engineering and Security Standards. Working as part of a leadership group, you’ll facilitate an engineering approach that is compliant to these standards and fosters sustainably excellent engineering.

• 
Working with your peers in Product and your team, assist in the development roadmaps and plans which effectively and efficiently deliver business outcomes.

• 
Stay up-to-date with emerging practices, technologies and frameworks.

• 
Work with engineers and customer facing teams to troubleshoot and resolve production issues, where appropriate.

• 
Coach and enable your team toward effective and efficient delivery.

Success looks like

• 
Empower & develop your team: Ensure everyone understands how their work drives Planday's success, is challenged to grow, and receives regular, timely feedback with clear development paths.

• 
Deliver high-quality software: Maintain a predictable pace of delivery that meets customer needs, complies with engineering standards, and communicates technical risks and scope expectations clearly.

• 
AI as a multiplier: You actively explore and adopt AI-assisted development tools and practices, enabling your team to work smarter, reduce repetitive effort, and push the boundaries of what a team can deliver.

• 
Foster a collaborative culture: Enable participation in communities, cross-team collaboration, and knowledge sharing both within and outside the team, modeling inclusion and continuous improvement.

• 
Remove barriers: Understand what drives your team's best work, actively clear blockers, and ensure operational hygiene (leave, expenses, processes) is handled smoothly.

What you’ll bring with you

• 
7+ years of experience in software engineering, with demonstrated experience leading or mentoring engineering teams in a SaaS environment.

• 
Deep technical expertise in at least one core language ideally the backend (C#, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript) and knowledge of modern front-end frameworks (React or Angular).

• 
Proven track record working with microservices architectures, cloud infrastructure (AWS/CDN), and robust public/private APIs.

• 
Experience with third-party software integrations (e.g., Payroll, HR, POS systems) and working within certified security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC2).

• 
Pragmatic, "hands-on" technical leadership balance—equally comfortable diving into architectural discussions, reviewing code, or guiding high-level product strategy.

• 
Strong communication skills with an ability to bridge technical requirements with business goals.

Ascendis Pharma is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Pharmacometrics department in Hellerup.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Student Assistant to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in supporting the maintenance and development of our pharmacometrics modelling platform, contributing to analyses used in drug development.

You will be joining the Pharmacometrics Department and be based in Hellerup. You will join a collaborative team of experienced pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and colleagues with recent experience as student helpers. You will gain hands-on experience working on real-world drug development challenges.

• Supporting QC of regulatory documents and calculations

• Have experience with Git

Want to work at the intersection of customer experience, digital solutions and commercial innovation?

This is your chance to be part of shaping how we create value for users and healthcare professionals — in a global MedTech company.

We are looking for two student assistants to join our Customer Experience organization at HQ in Humlebæk. One of our recent student assistants has just transitioned into a full-time role after two years in the team — and we are now looking for new talent to continue building the function.

In Customer Experience, we work to deliver superior customer experiences and be the trusted partner for our users/patients and healthcare professionals (e.g. nurses).

Join Customer Experience and collaborate across four global teams

You will be part of a newly established Customer Experience organization, working across four teams: User Experience, HCP Experience, Service Operational Excellence, and Digital Marketing & Demand Generation.

Together, we define, develop and implement the future customer experience — from understanding user needs and shaping digital journeys to creating content and enabling scalable solutions across markets. In this role, you will get hands-on experience working across all four teams and learn how different parts of a global commercial organization come together.

Build your commercial understanding and competencies

As a Student Assistant, you will work approx. 15–20 hours per week and support across the department — gaining exposure to a broad range of topics by collaborating across multiple teams, which is a unique opportunity in a student role. You will refer to a manager who will help you prioritize and develop in the role.

Tasks will vary, but are likely to include:

•    Supporting Customer Experience projects across user experience, HCP experience, service operations and digital marketing

•    Contributing to user research, customer insights and digital initiatives

•    Coordinating stakeholder input and helping drive activities across teams and markets

•    Assisting with PowerPoint preparation, project coordination and stakeholder input

•    Supporting the team with administrative and ad hoc tasks

A proactive student who enjoys creating impact and turning ideas into action

You are curious and motivated by creating impact. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating with different stakeholders and helping move initiatives forward. You are not afraid to challenge existing thinking, explore new ideas and turn opportunities into action.

We imagine that you:

•    Are currently studying a bachelor’s or master’s degree within business, marketing, digital, innovation or similar

•    Enjoy working across different teams, topics and problem types

•    Are proactive, pragmatic and motivated by getting things done

•    Have strong PowerPoint skills

•    Are fluent in English, written and spoken

•    Bring a commercial mindset and enjoy connecting the dots across disciplines

•    Enjoy working with people and building relationships across functions and markets

•    Experience with content platforms, Excel or design tools is a plus, but not a requirement

What we offer

You will become part of a global, purpose-driven organization with strong ambitions for Customer Experience. You will gain hands-on experience working across projects, teams and disciplines — and contribute to work that makes a real difference for users and healthcare professionals.

You will also have the opportunity to be part of Coloplast Young Professionals, a community where students and early-career colleagues connect, network and participate in both professional and social events across the organization.

Working in Humlebæk might feel far from your studies (e.g. in Copenhagen), but Coloplast offers a shuttle bus between the train station and the office. As you get into the role and become more confident in your tasks, you will also have flexibility to work from home when needed — especially during busy periods like exams.

Ready to apply?

If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply today. For more information about the role, feel free to reach out to Signe Bunke at dksbun@coloplast.com.

We will review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to submit yours. This position will remain open until the right candidate has been found.

Job Description

Do you want to take senior hands-on technical ownership of how mission-critical data centers are designed, expanded, and handed over for operation?

GlobalConnect is expanding data center capacity across the Nordics and Northern Europe. To support this growth, we are strengthening our Large Projects organization with a Data Center Designer based in Taastrup.

This is a senior specialist role at our highest specialist level. You will act as a technical authority across large data center projects, influence design direction, challenge key technical decisions, and help shape more consistent ways of working across countries.

The role is a hands-on role. You will work directly with layouts, power and cooling concepts, system architecture, technical documentation, supplier designs, commissioning readiness, and operational handover. This is not a technician or installation role, but you should enjoy getting close to the technical solution and being present in the data center environment.

What you need to succeed

• Hands on experience with data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments, such as energy, pharma, industrial facilities, or similar

• Strong understanding of cooling systems and power infrastructure in mission-critical environments

• Proven hands-on experience with alarm and monitoring systems, including system architecture and integration with critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and security

• Ability to interpret, review, and challenge engineering drawings, technical documentation, specifications, supplier designs, and system architecture choices

• Fluent English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage

About the role and the team

You will join a small, senior, and specialized team working across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Germany. The team works closely across borders and is building a more consistent pan-Nordic approach to data center design, expansion, and operational readiness.

In Denmark, this role closes an important capability gap. You will bring deep technical design expertise into a setup that already has strong project management capability. You will work closely with Project Managers, Sales, Procurement, external consultants, vendors, customers, and Operations.

A key part of the role is to act as a trusted technical advisor. You will help translate customer needs into technically sound solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure that design choices support long-term reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

What you’ll be working on

• Act as technical authority within large data center projects, from early concept through commissioning, acceptance, and handover
